features.text: post/compare/text: Compare texts and detect if one is translation or paraphrase of another (POST /compare/text)
post/compare/text/summarization: Compare texts and detect if one is summarization of another (POST /compare/text/summarization)

get/compare/text/{requestId}: Return text comparing status.
Also return probability if one text is paraphrasing or translation of another (GET /compare/text/{requestId})
get/compare/hc: Health check for all comparer services. (GET /compare/hc)
post/detect/document: Obsolete. Will be removed in the next version, use /detect/paraphrase/document/ instead this. (POST /detect/document)
post/detect/paraphrase/document: Detect paraphrasing in the document (POST /detect/paraphrase/document)
post/detect/summarization/document: Detect summarization in the document (POST /detect/summarization/document)
post/detect/ai-generation/document: Detect ai generated text in the document (POST /detect/ai-generation/document)
post/detect/ocr: Obsolete. Will be removed in the next version, use /detect/paraphrase/ocr instead this. (POST /detect/ocr)
post/detect/paraphrase/ocr: Detect paraphrasing in the image or scanned document (POST /detect/paraphrase/ocr)
post/detect/summarization/ocr: Detect summarization in the image or scanned document (POST /detect/summarization/ocr)
post/detect/ai-generation/ocr: Detect ai generation content in the image or scanned document (POST /detect/ai-generation/ocr)
post/detect/document/trial: Trial detect paraphrasing in the document (POST /detect/document/trial)
post/detect/text: Obsolete. Will be removed in the next version, use /detect/paraphrase/text instead this. (POST /detect/text)
post/detect/paraphrase/text: Detect paraphrasing in text (POST /detect/paraphrase/text)
post/detect/summarization/text: Detect summarization in text (POST /detect/summarization/text)
post/detect/ai-generation/text: Detect ai generated text (POST /detect/ai-generation/text)
post/detect/text/trial: Trial detect paraphrasing in text (POST /detect/text/trial)

get/detect/document/{requestId}: Return document detection status.
Also return probability of paraphrasing for the whole document and per paragraph (GET /detect/document/{requestId})

get/detect/text/{requestId}: Return text detection status.
Also return probability of paraphrasing for the whole text (GET /detect/text/{requestId})
get/detect/hc: Health check for detect all services. (GET /detect/hc)
post/estimate/document: Estimate grade of the document (POST /estimate/document)
get/estimate/document/{requestId}: Return essay estimate grade. (GET /estimate/document/{requestId})
